formal_core.statement: Time is the modular flow of the state: σ_t^ω = Δ^{it} A Δ^{-it} (Tomita–Takesaki; Connes–Rovelli thermal time). The state determines the time. The moment-triad (emergence–persistence–withdrawal) is the structure of state transition. Adequate determinism = deterministic modular flow within a state, random transitions between states.

supports.source: Spanda: non-sequential action is the source of time
Ñāṇavīra: time is the present hierarchy

gaps: No experiment distinguishes thermal time from extrinsic time
